            show a + 1 + 1 = a + 2 by omega, ih.1, ih.2]
          simp only [Nat.mul_add, Nat.add_mul, Nat.mul_assoc]
          omega
    intro a
    exact (h a).1
  have L : ∀ a b, Nat.gcd (u b) (u (a + b)) = Nat.gcd (u b) (u a) := by
    intro a b
    cases b with
    | zero => rw [Nat.add_zero]
    | succ k =>
      rw [show a + (k + 1) = a + k + 1 by omega, add k a, gadd',
        Nat.mul_right_comm 3 (u a) (u k), Nat.gcd_comm (u (k+1)) (3 * u k * u a),
        cancel (3 * u k) (u a) (u (k+1)) (hc k)]
      exact Nat.gcd_comm _ _
  have rep : ∀ m q r, Nat.gcd (u m) (u (r + m * q)) = Nat.gcd (u m) (u r) := by
    intro m q r
    induction q with
    | zero => rw [Nat.mul_zero, Nat.add_zero]
    | succ q ih =>
      rw [Nat.mul_add, Nat.mul_one, ← Nat.add_assoc, L (r + m * q) m, ih]
  have key : ∀ s m n, m < s → Nat.gcd (u m) (u n) = u (Nat.gcd m n) := by
    intro s
    induction s with
    | zero => intro m n hm; exact absurd hm (Nat.not_lt_zero m)
    | succ s ihs =>
      intro m n hm
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos m with h | h
      · subst h
        have h0 : u 0 = 0 := rfl
        rw [h0, Nat.gcd_zero_left, Nat.gcd_zero_left]
      · have hlt : n % m < s := by
          have := Nat.mod_lt n h
          omega
        have ih' := ihs (n % m) m hlt
        rw [Nat.gcd_rec m n, ← ih', Nat.gcd_comm (u (n % m)) (u m),
          ← rep m (n / m) (n % m), Nat.mod_add_div n m]
  exact key (m+1) m n (Nat.lt_succ_self m)
